lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还记得翻修种植间那户人家吗？他们又来问了。
lines.en: Remember the family renovating their growing room? They came asking again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那批一件都没退。这回先问下一批什么时候能看，还问是不是仍由我经手。
lines.en: Not one piece from the last lot was returned. This time they asked when they could see the next batch, and whether I'd still be handling it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我先问他们要什么、什么时候要。我没答应每回都能变出货，等他们的单子。
lines.en: I asked what they need and when. I didn't promise I could produce stock every time. I'm waiting for their order.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前别人来找我，多半想打听母亲的事。这回他们先问的是我。
lines.en: ...Before, when people came to me, it was usually to ask about Mother. This time they asked about me first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这是你自己挣来的。
lines.en: You earned that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我知道。所以才第一个来告诉你。
lines.en: I know. That's why I wanted to tell you first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲接出来了！我先安顿好她，就赶过来了。本来想等你开门……还是来早了。
lines.en: My mother's out! I got her settled and came straight here. I meant to wait for you to open... I'm early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来说。
lines.en: Come inside.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲安全转出来了！我刚从她那儿过来。本来想等你开门……还是来早了。
lines.en: My mother's been moved out safely! I just came from seeing her. I meant to wait for you to open... I'm early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来说。
lines.en: Come inside.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天轮到我来接你了。
lines.en: Today it's my turn to pick you up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这身是穿给谁看的？
lines.en: ...Who are you wearing that for?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先看。看够了再问。……算了，再多给你看一会儿。
lines.en: You look first. Ask when you've looked enough. ...Fine. I'll let you look a little longer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面有一场晚会。请柬上有一栏，要填同行人的名字。
lines.en: There's a party upstairs. The invitation has a space for a companion's name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 想被填进去的人太多了。有人送花，有人留座位，还有人提醒我，带一位“合适的男伴”对生意有好处。上回推掉的那张饭桌也在里面。
lines.en: Too many people want that slot. Some send flowers, some save seats, and some remind me that bringing a 'suitable male companion' would be good for business. The dinner table I turned down last time is in there too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我提过你，可总有人以为我客气地谢一谢出钱的老板。
lines.en: I've mentioned you, but people still assume I'm just politely thanking the shopkeeper who put up the money.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以今晚要把话说清楚。我也想跟你跳支舞！别光听前半句。
lines.en: So tonight I'm making it clear. I want to dance with you too! Don't just hear the first half.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 穿件干净外套就行。我带的是你，跟衣服没关系。
lines.en: A clean coat is enough. I'm bringing you, not your clothes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你自己填。
lines.en: Fill it in yourself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 走吧。今晚的时间，归我了。
lines.en: Come on. Tonight, your time is mine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那场，我自己去了，同行人那一栏一直空着。
lines.en: I went to the last one alone. The companion line stayed empty.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有人问，我说他店里走不开。……下回你还走不开，我就直接去店里把你拎走！
lines.en: Someone asked, and I said you couldn't leave the shop. ...If you can't leave next time either, I'll come drag you out myself!

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 报纸写到我们了！“神秘男伴”——我明明告诉他们你是干什么的了。
lines.en: We're in the paper. 'Mysterious companion'—I told them exactly what you do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就让他们来。问价的时候，你照常算。你也照常——生意归生意，别的等客人走了再说。
lines.en: Then let them come. When they ask the price, quote it as usual. And as usual—business is business. The rest waits until the customers are gone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回说好，下一场要把时间留给我。现在关门了，能陪我走了吗？
lines.en: You promised me the next party. The shop is closing now. Can you come with me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天的时间留出来了吗？请柬我带来了，同行人还是你自己写。
lines.en: Did you keep the time clear today? I brought the invitation. You still fill in your companion yourself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那场没赶上。这次是另一场，请柬我带来了。现在能陪我去了吧？
lines.en: We missed that party. This is another one; I've brought the invitation. Can you come with me this time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好，那这场我自己去。你也早点休息，别又忙到半夜。
lines.en: ...All right. I will go on my own. Get some rest yourself. Do not work until midnight again.
